backtest.label: Real-Data Backtesting Engine
backtest.subtitle: Backtest single-asset strategies on historical market data and generate equity curves, drawdowns, and full performance metrics; execute signals at T+1 to avoid look-ahead bias.

calibration.label: Model Calibration Lab
calibration.subtitle: Fit GARCH / EWMA / Merton jump-diffusion models to real market data, calibrate volatility, and send results to pricing tools in one click.

visualization-guide.label: Visualization Components Workbench
visualization-guide.subtitle: Brush-linked zoom · Event annotations · Fan Chart confidence bands · Histogram KDE · PNG / CSV export · Color-vision friendly.

ashare-suite.label: A-shares Full-Stack Data · Quotes / Flows / Top Movers / Filings
ashare-suite.subtitle: Tencent quotes + East Money push2 + exchange top-mover lists + CNINFO filings, covering real-time quotes, daily K-lines, fund flows, and official disclosures across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing A-shares.

us-suite.label: U.S. Stocks Full-Stack Data · Quotes / Fundamentals / SEC / Options / Screening
us-suite.subtitle: Yahoo quotes and technical indicators, SEC XBRL financial statements, EDGAR filing search, option-chain Greeks, and cross-sectional screening.

tv-screener.label: TradingView Screener · Cross-Market Real-Time Scanning
tv-screener.subtitle: Query TradingView's public Scanner without an API key across stocks, FX, crypto, bonds, and futures, with flexible combinations of 13,000+ fields.

trillion-dollar-equation.label: The Trillion-Dollar Equation · The Black–Scholes Case in Full
trillion-dollar-equation.subtitle: A five-chapter deep dive: replication portfolios that eliminate direction, the gamma tax of discrete rebalancing, the volatility risk premium, and extensions.

ai-quant-strategy.label: When AI Told Me My Idea Was Backward · A Quant Strategy Case Study
ai-quant-strategy.subtitle: A five-chapter postmortem: why a factor portfolio generated from one prompt lost money for four years, how state dependence flipped the sign, and the 40% drawdown behind a +1047% backtest.

asset-pricing-theory.label: Asset Pricing Theory · From State Prices to the Modern Frontier
asset-pricing-theory.subtitle: The four-part framework of p=E[mx]: no-arbitrage and state prices, preferences and the three major puzzles, empirical tests (GRS/HJ distance), predictability and the factor zoo—with each topic linked to a reproducible lab.

econometrics-theory.label: Econometrics · From Data-Generating Processes to Credible Inference
econometrics-theory.subtitle: A five-step chain of reasoning: DGP → identification → estimation → inference → interpretation; seven identification strategies, five tiers of standard errors, and methods for high-dimensional heterogeneity, each linked to a reproducible lab.

time-series-theory.label: Time Series · From Stationarity to Density Forecast Evaluation
time-series-theory.subtitle: A six-layer framework: stationarity and preprocessing → linear representations → multivariate dynamics → nonlinearities and regimes → volatility and state space → forecast evaluation, with each topic linked to a reproducible lab.

portfolio-theory.label: Portfolio Theory · From Mean–Variance to Robust and Dynamic Allocation
portfolio-theory.subtitle: A six-layer framework: choice and geometry → equilibrium pricing → estimation and robustness → risk and constraints → active management and growth → dynamic and high-dimensional methods, with each topic linked to a reproducible lab.

derivatives-theory.label: Derivatives Pricing · From the Law of One Price to Rough Volatility
derivatives-theory.subtitle: A six-layer framework: no-arbitrage and state prices → replication and measures → model families → curves and credit → numerical methods → calibration and the frontier, with each topic linked to a reproducible lab.

risk-theory.label: Risk Management · From Metrics to Capital, Regulation, and Resilience
risk-theory.subtitle: Ten sections: the nature of risk → classification → market risk measurement → credit → liquidity → Basel/FRTB → crisis history → the frontier.

behavior-lab.label: Behavioral Finance Lab · From Prospect Theory to Limits to Arbitrage
behavior-lab.subtitle: Eight experiments: cumulative prospect theory, myopic loss aversion, BSV / DHS / Hong-Stein belief models, limits to arbitrage and forced liquidation, cross-sectional investor sentiment, and behavioral corporate finance.

behavior-theory.label: Behavioral Finance · Bounded Rationality and Limits to Arbitrage
behavior-theory.subtitle: Nine sections: core questions → two pillars → prospect theory → bias map → sentiment → limits to arbitrage → anomalies → the frontier.

macro-frontier.label: Macro Frontier Lab · From Growth Engines to Policy Rules
macro-frontier.subtitle: Twelve experiments: endogenous growth, growth accounting, fiscal multipliers, RBC, Calvo/NKPC, policy rules, parity and carry, sudden stops, QE/YCC, and climate transition.

macro-theory.label: Macroeconomics · Growth, Fluctuations, Policy, and the Open Economy
macro-theory.subtitle: Nine sections: microfoundations → long-run growth → short-run fluctuations → monetary policy → fiscal policy → the open economy → history of thought → the frontier → frameworks for judgment.

microstructure-lab.label: Market Microstructure Lab · Inventory, Information, and the Order Book
microstructure-lab.subtitle: Seventeen experiments: Stoll decomposition, Ho-Stoll quotes, PIN/VPIN, order-book simulation, spread conventions, information shares, and market design.

microstructure-theory.label: Market Microstructure · From Market Making to Market Design
microstructure-theory.subtitle: Nine sections: core questions → market organization → inventory and information → order books → liquidity measurement → price discovery → market design → the frontier.

fixed-income-frontier.label: Fixed-Income Frontier Lab · Curves, Spreads, and Structured Products
fixed-income-frontier.subtitle: Eighteen experiments: bootstrapping and interpolation, four spread conventions, embedded options and convertibles, structured credit, leverage, and the institutional frontier.

fixed-income-theory.label: Fixed Income · From Discount Factors to the Institutional Frontier
fixed-income-theory.subtitle: Nine sections: interest-rate terminology → duration and convexity → spread conventions → curve construction → dynamic models → structured credit → portfolio leverage.

micro-theory.label: Microeconomics · From Preferences to Mechanism Design
micro-theory.subtitle: Six sections: preferences and utility → production and costs → market structure → games and strategy → asymmetric information → mechanism design.

quant-theory.label: Quantitative Strategies · From Signals to Live-Trading Gaps
quant-theory.subtitle: Six sections: signal construction → portfolio construction → transaction costs → backtest bias checklist → performance metrics → live-trading gaps.

qlib-guide.label: Qlib Guide · A Reproducible Quant Research Pipeline
qlib-guide.subtitle: A seven-layer framework: data layer → expression factors → cross-sectional normalization → models → evaluation → TopK-Dropout → workflow.

qlib-lab.label: Qlib Pipeline Lab · From Factors to Portfolios
qlib-lab.subtitle: Reproduce the Qlib research loop: Alpha158-style factors, cross-sectional standardization, Ridge fitting, IC evaluation, and TopK-Dropout backtesting.
